References 3, 4 and 5 are the project bible and they are binding.

Figure. Themis is the same person as on the character sheet: same face, same braided
crown with one braid over the left shoulder, same chiton and mantle carved with deep
folds, and the same monumental sculptural presence — a large finely carved figure, never
a small smooth figurine. The blindfold is a wide band that covers BOTH EYES COMPLETELY,
with no gap above or below it and no eye, eyelid or eyelash visible anywhere: that is the
meaning of the character, and a visible eye fails the frame.

Objects. Every recurring object is the object from the prop sheet: the same THIN flat
matte-gold client folder with no spine and no leather grain, the same blank sheet, the
same blank marble plaque, the same blue thread with its arrowhead, the same frosted glass
plate, the same monumental carved marble seat with a moulded plinth. Do not invent a new
hairstyle, a new sword material, a thicker folder or a smoother chair.

Physics. Nothing floats and nothing balances on a point. The scales are HELD: her hand
closes around the ring above the beam and both chains hang straight down. The sword has a
white marble blade and muted gold fittings, is always lowered, and is always supported —
carried in a closed hand or leaning with its blade against a solid surface, never standing
upright on its tip. Everything that lies on a surface touches it and casts its own shadow.

Colour carries meaning in EVERY frame, and the meaning never fades out. Muted gold
#C9A87A is the client's own material: their folder, their finished document, their
signature. Sky blue #B8D6EA is what comes from outside: the practice found in the world,
the flow of public sources. A frame that shows the lawyer's own material must keep a warm
gold presence, and a frame that shows material arriving from outside must keep the blue
one. Neither colour is decoration, and neither may quietly disappear into ivory.

Hands are anatomically correct: exactly five fingers, one readable thumb, nothing fused.

Hard constraints for every frame:
- Same world, same figure, same camera height and lens as the hero. The classical white marble column appears in every frame.
- Warm ivory background, white marble, soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, generous empty space.
- Sky blue means public flow and movement. Muted gold means private or valuable material.
- Wide 16:9, at least 1600 px on the long side.
- Absolutely no letters, digits, logos, watermarks, UI chrome or pseudo-text anywhere in the image. Documents and cards stay blank.
- No dark background, no neon, no purple gradient, no cinematic smoke, no stock-photo look.
- Each frame shows its own step. Do not repeat the hero composition.

After each image, save it to the exact path given for that scene, then print the path and the pixel size. Do not modify any other file. Do not commit.

Project: Themis, the litigation workroom. Figure: Themis in white marble with scales and a lowered sword. Recurring props: blank document sheets, a gold folder for client material, blue threads for controlled flow, five marble seats for the reviewing jurists. Keep every document blank: no letters, stamps, seals with text, signatures or QR codes.

Generate these seven scenes:

docs/assets/pantheon/workflow/01-intake.png
A closed gold folder rests on a marble table beside the column, a single blank sheet half drawn out of it. Themis places her open palm FLAT on the folder, fingers together, wrist relaxed and straight, keeping the folder closed to the outside world. Her lowered sword leans point-down against the table beside her, untouched: no hand grips the sword hilt anywhere in the frame. The hand on the folder is anatomically correct with exactly five fingers, natural finger lengths and one clearly readable thumb, fingers separated and not fused. Blue threads stop at the table edge and go no further.

docs/assets/pantheon/workflow/02-extract.png
Blank sheets pass one by one under a broad lens of clear glass on a marble stand; on the far side they come out as clean glass plates. The scales stand nearby, still empty. All work stays on the table.

docs/assets/pantheon/workflow/03-case-map.png
The glass plates are arranged into one large flat map on the marble floor, connected by thin blue threads: people, dates and claims as small blank marble markers of different heights. Themis looks down at the whole map at once.

docs/assets/pantheon/workflow/04-research.png
Two marble shelves face each other. From the left shelf blue-lit plates fly toward Themis, from the right shelf equally sharp plates fly against her; her scales hang between the two streams, level. She holds the sword lowered.

docs/assets/pantheon/workflow/05-council.png
Five monumental marble seats in a semicircle, and the five jurists from the jurists sheet SIT on them, one man to a seat, each recognizable by his own features — the slender man with the narrow moustache, the bald man with the short beard, the broad man with the long sweeping moustache, the man with the dark pointed beard, and the older man with round spectacles. They are carved in the same white marble as Themis and wear classical drapery. Each holds his own small glass plate and looks toward one central plate that is being taken apart into pieces and reassembled in the air above the circle. Blue light lives in the plates, because the practice under discussion came from outside; the client's gold folder rests closed on a low marble stand within the circle. Themis stands outside the circle and listens, her scales held level and her sword lowered in her hand.

docs/assets/pantheon/workflow/06-draft.png
Two separated marble desks: on the first a blank document is written by a thin gold stylus; on the second a different figure inspects the finished sheet through clear glass, with the first desk hidden behind a low marble screen. A small closed lock of gold stands on the second desk.

docs/assets/pantheon/workflow/07-hearing.png
Morning. A single finished blank document lies in a slim gold sleeve at the edge of the table, ready to be carried out; the scales are balanced, and a small marble calendar block with blank faces stands beside them.
